meta.source: League Remote design tokens, iOS 26/27 Liquid Glass conventions

dynamicType.usage: Dynamic Type growth caps: type styles grow to their maxFontSize (AX5), spacing to 1.25× and sizes to 1.5× of the default; dynamic:false tokens never grow.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background (iOS systemGroupedBackground). Everything scrolls on it; inset list sections and cards sit on it in bg-elevated.

tokens.name: bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Inset-grouped list sections, cards, opaque sheets at the large detent (secondarySystemGroupedBackground).

tokens.name: bg-tertiary
tokens.usage: Wells inside an elevated surface: code-digit boxes, spell slots, the enemy-team strip (tertiarySystemGroupedBackground).

tokens.name: row-pressed
tokens.usage: Highlight of a list row or tile while the finger is down (systemGray4). Shown on pointer-down, removed on release.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text and symbols on bg, bg-elevated, bg-tertiary and glass.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text (subtitles, values, footers) on bg, bg-elevated and bg-tertiary. Opaque on purpose: Apple's 60%-alpha secondaryLabel is only 3.5:1 on white; this value keeps 4.5:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: label-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and disabled labels only — never for text people must read.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairline (0.5px) between list rows, inset to the text start. Never a border around cards.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Switch off-track, slider track, progress-ring track (systemFill).

tokens.name: fill-secondary
tokens.usage: Gray (non-glass) buttons inside content and the avatar monogram ground (secondarySystemFill).

tokens.name: fill-tertiary
tokens.usage: Search field, role tags, empty champion slots (tertiarySystemFill).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hextech gold — the app tint. Fill of the ONE prominent action per screen (Find Match, Lock In, Scan QR Code), switch-free selection rings and the selected champion ring. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Labels and symbols on an accent fill (7:1+ in every theme). Never white on gold.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Gold as text or a symbol: links, "Pair Again…", the active step, your own row title. On bg, bg-elevated and bg-tertiary.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind your own team row and an incoming swap request. accent-text and label stay legible on it.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: System red. Ban button fill, Decline circle, enemy markers, destructive symbols, badges. Text uses red-text; symbols on it use on-red.

tokens.name: red-text
tokens.usage: Red as body-size text: Unpair, Blocked, error banners. On bg, bg-elevated.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: System orange. Status dots and symbols for warnings / reconnecting, always next to a word (as a mark it is only ~2:1 on light grounds). Text uses orange-text.

tokens.name: orange-text
tokens.usage: Orange as body-size text ("Reconnecting…"). On bg, bg-elevated.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: System green. Accept circle, online/connected dots (always next to a word: ~2:1 on light grounds), switch on-track. Text uses green-text; symbols on it use on-green.

tokens.name: green-text
tokens.usage: Green as body-size text ("Online", "Connected"). On bg, bg-elevated.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: System blue. Your team (ally) markers, info tips, the notification icon tile.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: System cyan. Available to coloured icon tiles (game modes use tile-dark).

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: System mint. Available to coloured icon tiles (game modes use tile-dark).

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: System indigo. Available to coloured icon tiles (game modes use tile-dark).

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: System purple. Available to coloured icon tiles (game modes use tile-dark).

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Sounds icon tile.

tokens.name: gray
tokens.usage: Neutral icon tiles (Connector, Game Client) and offline/unknown status dots.

tokens.name: tile-dark
tokens.usage: Dark gray icon tile behind the white symbol: every game mode on Play and in the Game Mode sheet (one quiet colour for the list).

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Symbols and labels on a red fill (Decline circle, Ban button). Black in Dark · Increased Contrast, where the red is lighter.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Symbols on a green fill (Accept circle). Dark on purpose: white on system green is 2:1.

tokens.name: on-tile
tokens.usage: The white symbol inside a coloured icon tile (decorative; the row label carries meaning).

tokens.name: ally
tokens.usage: Your team: small markers and the ally side of the bans row.

tokens.name: enemy
tokens.usage: The enemy team: locked-pick ring and enemy bans label.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Liquid Glass (regular) fill for floating controls: nav-bar buttons, the action bar, banners, menus. Always with backdrop-filter and the glass-rim shadow. Controls layer only, never content.

tokens.name: glass-thick
tokens.usage: Larger glass that carries text: sheets at partial height, alerts, menus, the picker sheet header.

tokens.name: glass-clear
tokens.usage: Clear glass, ONLY over the camera feed in the QR scanner, always with the scrim behind it.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimming layer behind modal sheets and alerts, and under clear glass over bright camera content.

tokens.name: glow-pick
tokens.usage: Final seconds of your PICK (EdgeGlow): the bright core of the gold heartbeat glow on the left and right screen edges, the Lock In button's colour. Never the only signal: the timer turns red and ticks too.

tokens.name: glow-pick-soft
tokens.usage: The wide soft halo around glow-pick (EdgeGlow), swelling a beat behind the core.

tokens.name: glow-ban
tokens.usage: Final seconds of your BAN (EdgeGlow): the bright core of the red heartbeat glow on the left and right screen edges, the Ban button's colour.

tokens.name: glow-ban-soft
tokens.usage: The wide soft halo around glow-ban (EdgeGlow).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline (2px, offset 2px) for hardware-keyboard / desktop use. Touch never shows it.

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: Switch and slider thumbs (white in every theme, like iOS).

tokens.name: thumb-pressed
tokens.usage: Switch thumb while pressed: it turns to glass and stretches (iOS 26).

tokens.name: segment-thumb
tokens.usage: The selected segment's thumb in a segmented control (LrSegmented) on its fill-tertiary track: white in light, systemGray3 in dark (iOS). Labels on it stay label.

tokens.name: camera
tokens.usage: Ground of the camera cover (Scanner) before the feed starts.

tokens.name: on-camera
tokens.usage: Text and symbols over the camera feed (viewfinder, hint, clear-glass buttons).

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, "SF Pro Text", "Inter Variable", Inter, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
families.rounded: ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", -apple-system, system-ui, "Inter Variable", Inter, sans-serif

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Navigation large title (bold, as iOS nav bars draw it). One per screen; collapses to the inline title on scroll.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Onboarding and empty-state titles (Pair with Your PC, Connector Offline).

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Sheet titles at the large detent, alert titles on the Ready Check.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Prominent section headers in content (Your Team, Party, Start a Lobby).

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Row titles that need emphasis, button labels, the inline nav title, banner titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text: list-row titles, descriptions, values. Never smaller for anything people must read.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: Know when a match is found, even with the app closed.

styles.name: subheadline
styles.usage: Row subtitles (champion under the role, map under the queue), search-field text.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Section footers, helper text under controls, the connection line in the nav subtitle.
styles.sample: Codes expire when the connector restarts.

styles.name: caption-1
styles.usage: Champion names under grid portraits, enemy role labels.

styles.name: caption-2
styles.usage: Smallest legal size: tags inside chips, ban counters. Semibold for legibility.

styles.name: clock-hero
styles.usage: In-game clock on the Live Game card while it is alone on the card (loading screen). Light weight, tabular figures, like the Clock app.

styles.name: clock-card
styles.usage: In-game clock on the Live Game card when the kill score shares the card: small enough to sit beside it at 375 px.

styles.name: countdown
styles.usage: Ready Check countdown inside the ring. Rounded face, tabular.

styles.name: timer
styles.usage: Champ-select turn timer in the picker header; orange-text under 10 s, red-text under 5 s.

styles.name: code-digit
styles.usage: One digit of the 6-digit pairing code.

styles.name: message
styles.usage: Chat bubbles and the message field: one step above body.

styles.name: tab-label
styles.usage: Tab bar labels. Bars keep their size at every text size, as on iOS.

spacing.note: 4-pt grid. Screen margin is space-5 (20), or space-6 (24) when the viewport is 428 px or wider. Spacing is in px at the default text size; implement as rem (÷17) so it grows with Dynamic Type.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a row title and its subtitle.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in tags; gap between champion grid tiles.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a group; glass-sheet inset from the screen edge at partial detents.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Icon tile to row text; vertical row padding (11–12) in list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: List-row horizontal padding; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen margin; sheet content padding; alert padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen margin at 428 px+; gap between a section header and the previous section's footer.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between list sections (header to previous section).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top padding of onboarding / empty-state content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space reserved above the action bar so the last row can scroll clear of it (plus the bar height).

tokens.name: banner-top
tokens.usage: Gap between the top safe area (status bar) and the first banner: clear of the blur iOS lays under the status bar.

tokens.name: banner-pad
tokens.usage: Inner padding of a banner (iOS notification proportions).

radius.note: Corners are concentric: an inner shape's radius = outer radius − the padding between them. Capsules use radius-full.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Summoner-spell icons at 18–20 px, ban icons.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Settings-style icon tiles (icon-tile).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Champion portraits in team rows (champ-row); spell slots (spell-slot).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Champion portraits at 56–64 px in the picker grid; code-digit boxes.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Inset-grouped list sections, cards, the Live Game card, tips (iOS 26 inset-grouped corner).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Alerts, menus, banners with actions, the floating glass sheet at partial detents.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of a sheet at the large detent (concentric with the iPhone display corner).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Capsules: every button, the action bar, tags, search field, toggles, status pill.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App mark tile (88px): the home-screen icon corner.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles; the corners between bubbles of one run use radius-sm.

tokens.name: radius-banner
tokens.usage: Toast banners (iOS notification banner corner).

shadow.note: Glass is drawn with a rim (inset shadows: darker outer edge + bright top specular, the iOS 27 look) plus a soft drop shadow. Content cards have no shadow.

tokens.name: glass-rim
tokens.usage: Every glass surface (glass, glass-thick, glass-clear). Combine with glass-lift.

tokens.name: glass-lift
tokens.usage: Drop shadow under floating glass: action bar, nav buttons, banners, menus. Bigger surfaces get sheet-lift.

tokens.name: sheet-lift
tokens.usage: Sheets and the Ready Check buttons' platter.

tokens.name: thumb-shadow
tokens.usage: Switch and slider thumbs.

tokens.name: camera-shadow
tokens.usage: Viewfinder brackets over a bright camera feed (drop-shadow).

size.note: Component sizes in px at the default text size.

tokens.name: hit-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit region for anything tappable (HIG). Pad small visuals up to it.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small capsule buttons inside rows (Enable, Accept in a banner).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Glass circle buttons in the nav bar and sheets; search field height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The primary capsule in the action bar and full-width buttons.

tokens.name: call-button
tokens.usage: Accept / Decline circles on the Ready Check (incoming-call layout).

tokens.name: row-min
tokens.usage: List row minimum height with an icon tile or avatar; text-only rows use row-min-text.

tokens.name: row-min-text
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a text-only list row (no icon tile or avatar).

tokens.name: icon-tile
tokens.usage: Settings-style coloured icon tile at the start of a row.

tokens.name: symbol
tokens.usage: Default icon size in rows, buttons and the nav bar (Lucide at stroke 1.75).

tokens.name: champ-grid
tokens.usage: Champion portrait in the picker grid.

tokens.name: champ-row
tokens.usage: Champion portrait in a team row (Your Team and Enemy Team).

tokens.name: champ-ban
tokens.usage: Ban portrait.

tokens.name: grabber-w
tokens.usage: Sheet grabber width (5 px tall, radius-full, label-tertiary).

tokens.name: symbol-xs
tokens.usage: Glyphs inside small shapes: tag icons, the search clear button.

tokens.name: chevron
tokens.usage: Disclosure chevron at the end of a list row.

tokens.name: symbol-sm
tokens.usage: Small symbols: pop-up chevrons, the leader crown, tip close, menu checkmarks (stroke 2).

tokens.name: symbol-lg
tokens.usage: Nav-bar and tab-bar symbols.

tokens.name: symbol-xl
tokens.usage: Tip symbol, onboarding feature symbols (stroke 1.6).

tokens.name: symbol-call
tokens.usage: Symbols in the Ready Check call buttons.

tokens.name: symbol-hero
tokens.usage: Empty-state symbol (stroke 1.5).

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: Status dot before a status word.

tokens.name: avatar
tokens.usage: Monogram avatar (party members, direct messages): circles are people.

tokens.name: tag-h
tokens.usage: Height of a tag (role preferences, Picking, Sent).

tokens.name: badge
tokens.usage: Unread count badge at the end of a row.

tokens.name: badge-sm
tokens.usage: Unread count badge on a symbol (tab bar, nav button). Fixed at every text size, like the bar it sits on.

tokens.name: spell
tokens.usage: Summoner spell icon in a team row.

tokens.name: spell-slot
tokens.usage: Summoner spell icon inside a Loadout slot.

tokens.name: spell-grid
tokens.usage: Summoner spell icon in the spell picker grid.

tokens.name: art-sm
tokens.usage: Item, summoner spell and rune icons in a match-history strip (Profile: game rows, a game's player rows).

tokens.name: form-chip
tokens.usage: One game's W / L chip in the Profile's Recent Form strip (a win filled green, a loss ringed red: the letter says it too).

tokens.name: profile-icon
tokens.usage: The player's own profile icon at the top of the Profile tab (a circle: it's a person).

tokens.name: stat-min
tokens.usage: Minimum column width of a stat cell (value over label) in a stats grid (StatGrid): a team's totals in a game's details, your live stats and a live team's objectives.

tokens.name: code-box
tokens.usage: Height of a pairing-code box.

tokens.name: code-dash
tokens.usage: Width of the dash between the two halves of the pairing code.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Height of the floating tab bar capsule. Fixed at every text size, like an iOS tab bar.

tokens.name: switch-w
tokens.usage: Switch track width (iOS 26).

tokens.name: switch-h
tokens.usage: Switch track height.

tokens.name: switch-thumb
tokens.usage: Switch and slider thumb width.

tokens.name: switch-thumb-pressed
tokens.usage: Switch thumb width while pressed (it stretches).

tokens.name: slider-thumb-h
tokens.usage: Slider thumb height.

tokens.name: slider-track
tokens.usage: Slider track height.

tokens.name: grabber-h
tokens.usage: Sheet grabber height.

tokens.name: countdown-ring
tokens.usage: Ready Check countdown ring diameter (at most 60% of the width).

tokens.name: appmark
tokens.usage: App mark tile on the Pair screen.

tokens.name: viewfinder
tokens.usage: QR viewfinder (at most 68% of the width).

tokens.name: measure-narrow
tokens.usage: Max width of short centred text and controls: alerts, empty-state messages, the call buttons row.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of centred controls: banners, the pairing code, scanner controls.

tokens.name: menu-min
tokens.usage: Menu minimum width.

tokens.name: menu-max
tokens.usage: Menu maximum width.

tokens.name: edge-fade
tokens.usage: Height of the soft scroll-edge fade behind the action bar (plus the safe area).

tokens.name: edge-glow-core
tokens.usage: Reach of the bright core of the final-seconds glow (EdgeGlow) in from each side edge. Fixed: it belongs to the screen edge, not the text.

tokens.name: edge-glow-halo
tokens.usage: Reach of the soft halo of the final-seconds glow (EdgeGlow) in from each side edge.

tokens.name: sheet-peek
tokens.usage: Default peek detent of a sheet (scaled with the text size).

tokens.name: picker-peek
tokens.usage: Champion picker peek: turn header and search above the full-width Lock In (control-lg).

tokens.name: tab-symbol
tokens.usage: Tab bar symbols (fixed at every text size).

tokens.name: banner-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a toast banner: an iOS notification banner, title and one line of text.

tokens.name: skin-card-h
tokens.usage: Height of a skin card in the Skins carousel (Data Dragon loading art, 308:560); also capped by the viewport height. Fixed: art doesn't grow with the text size.

tokens.name: chroma-swatch
tokens.usage: Chroma colour circle under a skin in the Skins carousel (padded to hit-min).

tokens.name: z-edge
tokens.usage: Scroll-edge effect bands.

tokens.name: z-chrome
tokens.usage: Nav bar and action bar (floating glass).

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-cover
tokens.usage: Full-screen covers: Ready Check, QR scanner.

tokens.name: z-banner
tokens.usage: Banners (so an error is visible over the Ready Check).

tokens.name: z-alert
tokens.usage: Alerts and action sheets.

tokens.name: z-over-sheet
tokens.usage: The action bar while it floats over the champion picker sheet.

tokens.name: z-edge-glow
tokens.usage: The final-seconds side glow (EdgeGlow): over sheets, under the action bar, banners and alerts. Never takes touches.

duration.note: Springs have no fixed duration; these are the settle times of the CSS linear() approximations in easing, for transitions that cannot be driven by JS.

tokens.name: dur-press
tokens.usage: Press-down highlight / scale-in (instant feel).

tokens.name: dur-snappy
tokens.usage: spring-snappy settle: toggles, segmented thumbs, menus, banners.

tokens.name: dur-smooth
tokens.usage: spring-smooth settle: view changes, cards appearing, the nav title swap.

tokens.name: dur-bouncy
tokens.usage: spring-bouncy settle: only after momentum (sheet flick, lock-in pop).

tokens.name: dur-fade
tokens.usage: Reduce Motion cross-fade replacing every slide/scale.

tokens.name: dur-step
tokens.usage: The app clock tick (store.now) and the linear step of a countdown between ticks.

tokens.name: dur-shake
tokens.usage: Rejected pairing code shake.

tokens.name: dur-tick
tokens.usage: 1 Hz loops: the urgent timer tick, the text caret.

tokens.name: dur-spin
tokens.usage: One turn of the activity indicator (8 steps).

tokens.name: dur-shimmer
tokens.usage: Loading shimmer on Data Dragon art.

tokens.name: dur-progress
tokens.usage: Indeterminate progress bar sweep.

tokens.name: dur-pulse
tokens.usage: Pulsing dots, the breathing Accept ring, acting portraits. Off under Reduce Motion.

tokens.name: dur-banner
tokens.usage: Info / success banner on screen (paused while touched).

tokens.name: dur-banner-error
tokens.usage: Error banner on screen.

easing.note: spring-* are Apple-style springs (response / damping ratio) sampled into CSS linear(). Use JS springs (animateSpring in lib/spring.ts) for anything a finger drives.

tokens.name: spring-smooth
tokens.usage: Response 0.4 s, damping 1.0 — the default for anything that moves on its own.

tokens.name: spring-snappy
tokens.usage: Response 0.3 s, damping 1.0 (same curve, use with dur-snappy).

tokens.name: spring-bouncy
tokens.usage: Response 0.4 s, damping 0.8 — after a flick or a commit (lock-in pop). Never on things that just appear.

tokens.name: ease-fade
tokens.usage: Opacity-only cross-fades (Reduce Motion, text swaps).

tokens.name: spring-smooth
tokens.usage: JS springs (useSpring) for anything that moves on its own; same curve as the spring-smooth easing.

tokens.name: spring-snappy
tokens.usage: JS springs for controls, menus, banners; same curve as spring-snappy.

tokens.name: spring-bouncy
tokens.usage: JS springs only after momentum (a flick); same curve as spring-bouncy.
